derivation:
by
  exact Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom ℤ_[q] (integralClosure ℤ_[q] Kw)
explanation: Mathlib proves that the algebra map of any faithful integral algebra is a local homomorphism. Instantiate it with ℤ_[q] and its integral closure in Kw; integrality and faithful scalar action are supplied by instances. The local-ring and finite-dimensional assumptions are unnecessary.
